=Extract contact details from this text:
Store: {{ $json.sections.url }}
Header: ```{{ $json.sections.header }}```
Footer: ```{{ $json.sections.footer }}```
Main: ```{{ $json.sections.main }}```
Contact: ```{{ $json.sections.contact }}```
About: ```{{ $json.sections.about }}```
Return a JSON object with these exact fields:
- email: the email address (use empty string "" if not found)
- phone: the phone number (use empty string "" if not found)
- contact: the contact page URL (use empty string "" if not found)
- additional information: additional information on how to contact the owner like social media handle and such (Use empty string "" if not found)
- store_url: the store URL provided 
CRITICAL: Always return all three fields. Use "" (empty string) for any missing information. Never use null or omit fields.
